【原视频简介】
Ina Garten has spent decades teaching people how to make elegant, comforting food look effortless. So naturally, I looked at her chicken piccata and thought:

"Will it hot dog?"

Welcome back to The Hot Dog Project, this is not the food network,  where perfectly good recipes are taken completely out of context and stuffed into a bun.

In this episode, I attempt to turn Ina Garten's classic chicken piccata into a hot dog, combining crispy chicken, lemon, capers, buttery sauce, and the kind of culinary decision-making that probably shouldn't happen without adult supervision.

Will this become a surprisingly sophisticated hot dog worthy of the Barefoot Contessa herself? Or will the lemon, capers, and questionable bun-based engineering create something that should have stayed on the dinner plate?

There's only one way to find out.

🌭 New episodes every week as I attempt to turn famous dishes, celebrity recipes, restaurant favorites, and iconic meals into hot dogs.
